tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Emma speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Theo.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🥣 Yuki of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
Yuki waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
📖 Codex: Encore — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
